d: MLC Election 2026 ki 8 siton (shikshak va snatak nirvachan kshetr) ke natijon aur matganna ke bad rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke neta aur purv upmukhyamantri tejasvi yadav ne patna men ek tuphani pres konphrens ki. tejasvi yadav ne ek taraph jahan bhajpa ke 30 sal purane kile ko dhvast karne ka dava karte hue apni parti ki jit par khushi jataee, vahin chunav aayog aur rajy ki endie sarkar par ab tak ka sabse tikha hamla bola.
